fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: Red October. Snook strong just inside the passes (C&R); bait schools on the beach; mixed surf reds, snook, trout. LEMON BAY: schooling reds, trout, and snook on docks and flats; pompano in the pass. NEARSHORE: mangrove snapper, grunts, trout, and mackerel on 35-40 ft reefs; Spanish on bait in close. Gag season closed Sep 30. Baits: live shrimp, white bait, pinfish, small mullet.
redtide: FWC Sep 25: K. brevis background only in SWFL (Charlotte/Lee and offshore Monroe); not observed in Sarasota. No fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 2.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD. Manasota Key enterococci 10 on 9/21; Englewood Beach 10 CFU. No advisory.
fpl: Morning trackers: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota ~149 customers out; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
